story.title: Story 6: Legacy File-Store Retirement And Compatibility Cleanup

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the prior open finding `story6-user-prompt-smoothing-compat-write`, the directly touched smoothing runtime/test surfaces, active-path guard coverage, and the configured `npm run verify-all` story/epic gate. I did not perform a broad re-review beyond convergence against the prior blocker and touched surfaces.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: The smoothing persistence path now calls `persistTurnsWithRowFallback` instead of directly calling `input.store.writeTurns` (`src/thread/async-thread/services/user-prompt-smoothing-service.ts:265-275`). The helper uses `writeTurnRows` when row-level writes are available and falls back only when they are not (`src/thread/services/turn-service.ts:304-328`), and SQLite implements `writeTurnRows` (`src/thread/store/sqlite-thread-store.ts:1593-1668`). Regression evidence closes the exact prior gap: `tests/thread/user-prompt-smoothing-service.test.ts` adds `RowLevelOnlySqliteSmoothingStore`, makes compatibility `writeTurns` fail, verifies one row-level write, and passes; `tests/context-steward/runtime-capture-sqlite.test.ts` verifies production runtime user-prompt smoothing through the default SQLite store without creating `thread.json`, `messages.jsonl`, `turns.json`, or `chunks.json`; `tests/context-steward/legacy-source-truth-guard.test.ts:6-14` now includes `src/thread/async-thread/services/user-prompt-smoothing-service.ts` in active-path guard coverage.

verified: Scope-In-2 (remove or quarantine whole-array compatibility usage from active high-contention paths where row-level methods exist)
DoD-3 (compatibility method usage is retired, guarded, or labeled)

additionalObservations: `npm run verify-all` passed cleanly: service suite reported 570 passing tests, E2E suites passed, and the command exited 0 in `/tmp/pi-long-horizon-story6-followup-verifier.log`.

The active-path grep still finds `writeTurns(` in compatibility definitions and guarded fallback paths, but the directly touched production smoothing path no longer directly uses the whole-array compatibility write after SQLite cutover.
Focused follow-up evidence also preserves AC-7.4/TC-7.4a: runtime smoothing now persists through the SQLite default store and the test asserts live managed thread directories remain SQLite-only.
